t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two important features in this game, the first is that the gnomes will appear in fixed pairs, the second feature is that each gnome within a pair will lead to different forest. the goal is to reach the forest that currently has the most mushrooms, the number of mushrooms in each forest constantly changes. when you are in forest, press space key to collect mushroom, after pressing space key, number of mushroom harvested is revealed. the goal is to try to always go to the forest that contains the most mushrooms. the best hint is to recognise which colour gnome leads to which forest. to get a lot of mushroom, you need to maintin focus.

vb_textbox.text: it is important to understand these two features about this game, the first feature is that the gnomes will appear in fixed pairs like blue and purple, orange and brown, their positions may change but they will always appaer in these pairs. The second feature is that each gnome within a pair will lead to a different forest, bright forest with red basket and dark forest with yellow basket. the orange, green, red and blue gnomes guide you to the bright forest while the brown, pink, yellow and purple gnomes take you to the dark forest. the goal is to reach the forest that currently has the most mushroom. the number of mushrooms in each forest constantly changes. when you arrive in the forest, you should press the space key to collect mushrooms. after pressing the space key, the number of mushroom harvested is revealed. be aware that this number can change, there is tendency you will end up in a forest without any mushroom. at the end of each round, the number of mushrooms harvested will be added. the main thing is to reach the highest score possible as the score will be converted to bonus. so, try to always aim at the forest that has the most mushrooms. please note that the size, type and position of gnome are not relevant. the best hint is to recognise which colour gnome leads to which forest. the most important thing is to maintain focus and you will get a lot of mushrooms.
